description: Source code for handling Git tree objects, including reading, parsing, comparing, and traversing tree structures within a Git repository.

classes.name: struct tree
classes.description: Represents a Git tree object, including its buffer, size, and parsed state.

classes.name: struct object
classes.description: Generic object structure used in Git objects, with type and parsed state.

methods.name: read_tree_at
methods.description: Recursively reads a tree at a given path, applying a callback function to each entry.

methods.name: read_tree
methods.description: Initializes a buffer and calls read_tree_at to read a tree structure.

methods.name: base_name_compare
methods.description: Compares two base names with mode, considering directory slashes.

methods.name: df_name_compare
methods.description: Compares two names, treating directory and file entries as equal when conflicting.

methods.name: lookup_tree
methods.description: Looks up or creates a tree object from an object ID.

methods.name: parse_tree_buffer
methods.description: Parses a tree object buffer into a tree structure.

methods.name: repo_parse_tree_gently
methods.description: Reads and parses a tree object, with optional quiet on missing objects.

methods.name: free_tree_buffer
methods.description: Frees the buffer associated with a tree object.

methods.name: repo_parse_tree_indirect
methods.description: Peels an object to a tree type given its object ID.
